nombre_oficial.texto: The Ossuary Group and Cenote Xtoloc

frase_gancho.texto: The pyramid above the cave and the second great cenote.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Leaving the Great Leveling behind and heading south, the path enters a wooded area with two stops. The first is the Ossuary, a stepped pyramid of nine tiers, similar to El Castillo and built over an opening that descends into a natural cave. It was called the Tomb of the High Priest, but today it is thought that it was not a tomb. The second is Cenote Xtoloc, the second largest in the city. It was believed to supply everyday water, but today several researchers think that this division between sacred and profane water is too simple.
